messages.subject: on cross-level multilevel SEM
parts:
Hi, 

I'm currently trying to model Multilevel SEM where where  level 2 predictors are associated with level 1 outcomes (and  vice versa). The current syntax looks as if it only allowed within levels modeling. Do you have a solution to that? 

Thanks

messages.author: 89c9fc822e34b78c
messages.subject: Re: on cross-level multilevel SEM
parts:
On 9/15/18 4:56 PM, Cyanea Poon wrote:
> Hi,
>
> I'm currently trying to model Multilevel SEM where where  level 2
> predictors are associated with level 1 outcomes (and  vice versa). The
> current syntax looks as if it only allowed within levels modeling. Do
> you have a solution to that?

Mention the level-1 variable also in the level 2 block: this will
'split' the variabel into a level-1 and a level-2 part, and the level-2
part can be used in a 'cross-level' association.

Yves.
